summary: Comprehensive testing of iter 216h107 — Tender PDF Branding Override Panel. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI components verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix during backend testing, cleaned up at end
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 216h107 Tender PDF branding override feature fully verified. Backend PUT/GET endpoints accept tender_company_name (max 120 chars), tender_primary_color (hex validation), tender_logo_url (max 500 chars). Frontend ThemeSettingsPanel shows TenderBrandingSection with live PDF cover preview. All existing color override fields still work (regression OK).

backend_put_tender_fields.details: PUT /api/master-admin/theme/orgs/{org_id} accepts tender_company_name, tender_primary_color, tender_logo_url. Validation: invalid hex returns 400, >120 chars company name returns 422, >500 chars logo URL returns 422. Empty string clears override.

backend_get_tender_fields.details: GET /api/master-admin/theme/orgs/{org_id} returns persisted tender_* fields in theme_overrides object.

backend_existing_fields_regression.details: Existing color override fields (primary, accent, surface, text, text_muted, border, primary_hover) still work correctly.

frontend_theme_settings_panel.details: ThemeSettingsPanel loads at /master-admin?section=theme-settings. Org picker [data-testid=theme-org-picker] works.

frontend_tender_branding_section.details: TenderBrandingSection [data-testid=tender-branding-section] appears after selecting an org. Contains three input fields for tender_company_name, tender_primary_color, tender_logo_url.

frontend_live_preview.details: Live PDF cover preview [data-testid=tender-brand-preview] updates in real-time. Shows 'A pitch from {company_name} for your team' tinted in the selected primary color. Verified with 'Wolverhampton Fitness Co.' and '#FF8C00'.

frontend_save_clear_buttons.details: Save button [data-testid=theme-save] persists values. Clear button [data-testid=theme-clear] removes overrides. Values persist after page reload.

frontend_existing_overrides_regression.details: Existing color override fields [data-testid=theme-override-primary], [data-testid=theme-override-accent] still work. Existing theme preview [data-testid=theme-preview] still displays correctly.

notes: The CRM Tender Engine PDF resolver (_resolve_crm_brand in routes/crm_v2.py) priority order is: theme_overrides.tender_company_name > branding.company_name > org.name (if not platform org) > 'Pulse Fitness'. This was verified by code review. Full PDF rendering test with pypdf would require CRM user context and tender creation which is out of scope for this iteration's testing.
